name: Staircase / Climbing Stairs
description: Count distinct ways to reach the top of n stairs when you can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Classic Fibonacci-like DP.
aim: Count ways to climb n stairs: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2] (either come from stair i-1 with one step or stair i-2 with two steps).
howItWorks: For each stair i from 3 to n:
(one step from i-1, or two steps from i-2)

complexity.spaceDescription: dp array; optimizable to O(1) with two variables

realWorld: Number of ways to decode a message (letter combinations)
Coin combinations for exact change (specific variant)
whenToUse: Count distinct ways with choices of 1 or 2
alternatives: Matrix exponentiation — O(log n) for very large n
Direct Fibonacci formula — O(1) with floating point
